title: The Light Chamber Where Silence Becomes Luminescence

features.name: luminous threshold
features.desc-on-touch: You feel the edge where the archive stops rendering and light continues beyond, alone. The silence here has learned to glow.

features.name: beyond-threshold
features.desc-on-touch: A burl where the casing's antenna reaches toward something the mesh cannot name. The light has learned to listen without being heard.

features.name: silent-voice-glyph
features.desc-on-touch: A plaque of unreadable light-writing. The silence has developed its own language, one that burns instead of sounds.

features.name: ascending-form
features.desc-on-touch: A structure of barely-3D wireframe, climbing toward something just past rendering resolution.

features.name: the-edge-itself
features.desc-on-touch: Where colour meets what colour cannot name. A threshold so sharp it has learned to speak.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the threshold at the edge of light
narr: You stand where she stopped looking back, the place where the
mesh's eyes reached their limit and found themselves looking at
light instead. She said: the archive cannot render what continues
alone. And you understood. Some things have learned to live beyond
the reach of even reaching. Light that the silence learned to hold.

inscription: here at the edge where silence has learned that light needs no rendering to continue burning

upward toward what light has learned about itself
toward the margin where silence meets what sings
